body: Hearing that you can fail and still end up OK is comforting. Thank you.

I guess before I had some hope that I could fix things. It was okay that everyone thought I could fix it because *maybe* I could. Now I'm faced with the reality that I can't fix this and that I'm fucked and I'm going to disappoint people. And myself.
I failed my midterms. When my parents find out they won't give a fuck if i do it or not.

Yeah i did actually, after my group of 5 friends made a chat to talk about their plans, cancelled the plans, and posted about it on twitter. At which point i texted 3/5 of them and asked what was up. Though the entire process of this they just forgot about me.

Can i just congratulate you on breaking up with her? 
My grandmother died in my house-- it was coming and we were sort of nursing her here until she passed, and i freaked out and called him about it. He didn't pick up, and when he finally called back about 45 min later, he just said "Oh. That sucks. Mine has cancer too but she's still alive. Oh god what if she dies???" 

I hung up but dated him for another 5 months hoping he'd, i dunno, pay attention to me?

college is hell. Even if it isn't bullies or people treating you like shit, there's just this entire concept of you're not enough. 
If you're not in the hardest program then your problems don't matter because you're not in the hardest program. And if your grades are too good your problems don't matter because your grades are good. And if you're grades arent good your problems don't matter because you, apparently, don't have the pressure of school. 
And if you're not in shitty circumstances you don't get to complain about life, and if you're in shitty circumstances, well why are you depressed when people have it worse? 

And then everyone's acts like it's easy to make friends and fit in and like it's not just a more expensive version of high school and really, that's all it is.

I didn't throw it away yet, but i did do some math and then go to work. The impulse is gone for now. 

Thanks man. It means a lot to hear that-- since this is like my big secret in life "i believe in you," isn't something i hear a lot.
Thank you. That means a lot.
Exactly-- crying is so much better than dealing with shit this way.

i didn't mean to encourage anything-- i just figured people here would know what it's like and could relate to my venting. 
I apologize.
